_meta.description: Team-shared brand spec — replaces personal-asset-index.json from upstream huashu-design.
how_to_use: 1. Copy this file to your project root as `team-brand-spec.json`
2. Fill in real values for your team / product
3. Commit to the project repo (no secrets — this is shared, version-controlled)
safety: DO NOT put personal info (real name, personal email, WeChat ID).
DO NOT put secrets (API keys, tokens, signed URLs).
Use absolute paths only for assets inside the project repo, or use URLs to the allowlisted asset host.

brand.name: Example
forbidden_zones: No emoji icons in product UI

watermark._note: OPT-IN ONLY. Default in this fork is no watermark. Set `enabled: true` only if your studio explicitly wants one on animation exports.

product_assets._note: Required for physical products. For digital products use ui_screenshots instead.

ui_screenshots._note: Required for digital products (apps / sites / SaaS).

approved_asset_hosts._note: Internal hosts the skill is allowed to fetch from automatically. Mirrors references/security-config.md §1.2.

current_project._note: Optional — narrows the scope for this run.
current_project.name: Replace with project name
